meta.title: DA NANG 🇻🇳 | Exploring the GIANT Lady Buddha & Son Tra Peninsula!
meta.description:
🇻🇳 **WELCOME BACK TO 4GO TRAVELING!**

Today we're exploring one of Da Nang's most impressive landmarks — the enormous Lady Buddha statue at Linh Ung Pagoda!

Standing 67 metres tall, Lady Buddha overlooks the beautiful coastline of Da Nang from the Son Tra Peninsula.

Join us as we explore this incredible place, discover the temples and statues, take in the amazing views over the city and see what makes this one of Da Nang's must-visit attractions.

🐒 And of course, we're keeping an eye out for the famous monkeys that live around Son Tra!

We're a British family of four travelling the world, experiencing different countries, cultures and everything that comes with life on the road.

❤️ **HELP SUPPORT OUR ADVENTURE!**

If you enjoy our videos, please give this one a LIKE, leave us a COMMENT and SUBSCRIBE to **4Go Traveling**.

Every subscriber helps us grow our channel and hopefully keep our family travelling for longer!

🌏 **Follow our journey:**
Thailand 🇹🇭 → Laos 🇱🇦 → Vietnam 🇻🇳 → Japan 🇯🇵 (hopefully next!)

Thanks for watching and we'll see you in the next adventure!
